auth.label: Access Key
auth.description: Docmosis environment access key used to authenticate Cloud API requests. Create or copy it from your environment API Keys page in the Cloud Console: https://resources.docmosis.com/content/faq/where-are-my-api-keys-and-base-urls-for-my-environments

extraFields.label: API Base URL
extraFields.description: Docmosis processing-location base URL for the environment that holds your templates. Official US, Europe, and Australia examples are documented here: https://apidocs.docmosis.com/cloud/dws4/.

actions.name: render_document
actions.description: Render one Docmosis template with JSON data and return JSON-safe delivery metadata or an explicit base64 result file.

templateName.description: The Docmosis template path to render.

outputName.description: The output filename including the preferred extension.

data.description: The JSON data payload merged into the template.

storeTo.description: The optional Docmosis delivery target such as `mailto:person@example.com` or `s3:bucket,key`.

tags.description: The optional semicolon-delimited tags recorded against the render.

requestId.description: The optional request identifier echoed by Docmosis.

sourceId.description: The optional source identifier associated with the render.

mailSubject.description: The optional email subject when using mailto delivery.

mailBodyHtml.description: The optional HTML email body when using mailto delivery.

mailBodyText.description: The optional plain-text email body when using mailto delivery.

devMode.description: Whether Docmosis should render in development mode instead of strict production mode.

returnResultFileBase64.description: Whether the streamed result should be returned as base64 in the connector response.
